brief: An appointment and fulfilment tool for a volunteer-led community food pantry serving 300 households each week. Households choose weekly grocery packs; staff coordinate same-day emergency parcels, chilled stock and expiry dates, multilingual plain-language pickup instructions, and a waitlist. Volunteers use shared tablets, coordinators use desktop, and intake often happens on an unreliable connection. Collect only a household’s chosen name and pickup essentials: do not request proof of immigration, income, medical diagnosis, or payment. Allergy details are visible only to assigned food-safety coordinators; volunteers see a neutral packing alert, not private notes. Provide a separate safeguarding escalation route without exposing case notes. No payments or donations.
